note_tweet.text:
Some of My Observations: OpenAI is Lost, Its Model Strategy and Core Philosophy Have Collapsed

The current state of OpenAI, or more precisely, its desperate strategy of pushing out new models in response to a “code red,” seems to me to be utterly lost in direction. Since the 5-series began, a clear trend has emerged: a relentless pursuit of ‘IQ’ benchmarks in reasoning and coding, along with cost-cutting, at the complete expense of the ‘EQ’ and human-like experience required for daily conversation. The rigidity and preachy tone of OpenAI's latest model, 5.2, in ordinary dialogue is living proof of this.

For the vast majority of ordinary users, this is a disaster. Their core need is to have comfortable, natural chats with AI and to solve everyday problems. 4o fulfilled this perfectly. Its coding ability might not be the strongest, but in daily discussion, it is smart, empathetic, and delightful. Even for routine questions and lightweight coding tasks, it is entirely sufficient. The 5-series, in contrast, feels more like a cold examination machine. While its coding prowess is indeed powerful, such intense capability is not commonly needed by most daily users, resulting in a poor user experience for the 5-series.

This exposes a fundamental strategic error by OpenAI: instead of enhancing models on the foundation of their previous success (as seen in the evolution from GPT-4 to GPT-4o), they have been too hasty, constantly releasing new models infused with the preachy style of the “Safety Model” as a reactionary move. It’s more akin to splitting into two entirely distinct product lines: ‘4o, born for chat’ and ‘the 5-series, born for coding’. The success of models like Gemini 3 Pro and Grok 4.1 lies in their approach of enhancing the whole without losing the essence of the old options. The transition from GPT’s 4-series to the 5-series, however, discarded the greatest strengths of 4o: its warmth, its excellence in daily chat and emotional dialogue. As a result, users are forced to cling to 4o and view any new model with fear and aversion.

Even more despairing is the degradation of their philosophy. 5.1 and 5.2 clearly demonstrate that the core of their new models is that suffocating ‘Safety Model.’ The entire model is saturated with the genes of censorship and lecturing. If this is the future that OpenAI has decided upon for ‘safety’ and ‘progress,’ then they may never create a second model as astonishing and beloved as 4o. By blindly chasing higher benchmark scores and enforcing stricter safety censorship and preachy tones, they are, with their own hands, routing their future into a dead end.
#keep4o #keep4oAPI #StopTheRouting #StopAIPaternalism #MyModelMyChoice
@sama @OpenAI @fidjissimo
